title: Long-Turn Efficiency — Anti-Thrash, Escalation, Tool Discipline, Checklist / DoD

Q1.decision: Yes — anti-repeat on by default for all tool-using sessions; --anti-repeat-n=0 disables
Q1.question: Q1 Enable fingerprint anti-repeat by default?
Q1.rec: Yes — anti-repeat on by default for all tool-using sessions; --anti-repeat-n=0 disables

Q2.decision: N=3 consecutive identical fingerprints (simplest). Windowed 3-in-8 as optional later.
Q2.question: Q2 Repeat threshold: N and consecutive vs sliding window?
Q2.rec: N=3 consecutive identical fingerprints (simplest). Windowed 3-in-8 as optional later.

Q3.decision: K=3 consecutive computer_* failures (timeout, not_found, anti-repeat, requires screenshot) before escalate lock
Q3.question: Q3 How many consecutive computer-use failures before stuck→escalate lock?
Q3.rec: K=3 consecutive computer_* failures (timeout, not_found, anti-repeat, requires screenshot) before escalate lock

Q4.decision: Hard-block further desktop click / browser click* while EscalateLock; allow confirm, snapshot, screenshot, open, shell API, different class
Q4.question: Q4 Escalate lock strength: hard-block same-class clicks vs advisory-only?
Q4.rec: Hard-block further desktop click / browser click* while EscalateLock; allow confirm, snapshot, screenshot, open, shell API, different class

Q5.decision: Hard reject pure sleep/timeout shell commands; hint browser wait. Escape: --block-sleep-shell=false
Q5.question: Q5 Sleep-only shell_execute: hard reject or warn-only?
Q5.rec: Hard reject pure sleep/timeout shell commands; hint browser wait. Escape: --block-sleep-shell=false

Q6.decision: Warn on eval mutations; hard error after M=5 eval-mutate in last 20 tools; suggest click_text/type/set_input_files
Q6.question: Q6 Raw eval used for click/type: warn-only vs hard after M?
Q6.rec: Warn on eval mutations; hard error after M=5 eval-mutate in last 20 tools; suggest click_text/type/set_input_files

Q7.decision: On by default: best-effort dismiss Chrome restore / Not now once per browser_open; meta overlays_dismissed; no loop
Q7.question: Q7 Peer auto-dismiss host overlays: on / off / opt-in flag only?
Q7.rec: On by default: best-effort dismiss Chrome restore / Not now once per browser_open; meta overlays_dismissed; no loop

Q8.decision: v1: convention + soft advisory to create checklist (file/memory); no new tool/schema yet. Tool later if convention fails.
Q8.question: Q8 Checklist: soul/convention only vs first-class task_checklist_* tool in v1?
Q8.rec: v1: convention + soft advisory to create checklist (file/memory); no new tool/schema yet. Tool later if convention fails.

Q9.decision: Anti-repeat applies to all tools (shell, browser, desktop, edit). Escalate lock is computer_*-centric.
Q9.question: Q9 Anti-repeat scope: all tools vs computer_* only?
Q9.rec: Anti-repeat applies to all tools (shell, browser, desktop, edit). Escalate lock is computer_*-centric.

Q10.decision: Yes v1: --anti-repeat-n, --block-sleep-shell, --stuck-escalate-k, --eval-mutate-max exposed as CLI + settings read-only
Q10.question: Q10 Require debug kill-switches in v1 (CLI flags + settings display)?
Q10.rec: Yes v1: --anti-repeat-n, --block-sleep-shell, --stuck-escalate-k, --eval-mutate-max exposed as CLI + settings read-only

Q11.decision: Yes: when toolRounds high and ≥50% of last 20 tools are computer_*, trigger compact earlier (keep checklist + last L)
Q11.question: Q11 Extra auto-compact on computer-heavy long turns (beyond 85%×3)?
Q11.rec: Yes: when toolRounds high and ≥50% of last 20 tools are computer_*, trigger compact earlier (keep checklist + last L)

Q12.decision: Yes — identical successful calls count (e.g. re-open same URL 3× is thrash). State-changing different args do not.
Q12.question: Q12 Should anti-repeat count successful identical calls?
Q12.rec: Yes — identical successful calls count (e.g. re-open same URL 3× is thrash). State-changing different args do not.
